about_short_description.short_description: Pathfinder is an information technology company that provides AI-based retail intelligence solutions for brands and companies.

product.name: RetailGPT Platform
product.description: A platform integrating physical and digital retail operations to streamline order management, payment processing, and delivery coordination.

product.name: Property Management Software
product.description: Software to manage rental revenues, automate billing, and centralize tenant information for franchises, airports, shopping centers, and governments.

product.name: Revenue Assurance Solution
product.description: A system that ensures accurate, real-time sales data reporting and on-time billing to support revenue growth for airports, shopping centers, governments, and franchise brands.

product.name: Phygital Engagement Services
product.description: Services that combine physical and digital retail elements to enhance shopper loyalty through loyalty programs, gamification, wayfinding, and personalized rewards.
